name: stoneward
description: Surgebinders who wield Cohesion and Tension. Stonewards are the bulwarks of the Knights Radiant, dependable, unyielding, and always at the front lines when others falter. They are builders and defenders, known for their endurance and loyalty.
sprenDescription: A sturdy, mineral-like figure with crystalline features and an unshakeable presence. Peakspren are dependable, stoic, and endlessly patient.

ideals.label: first ideal
ideals.description: The universal Ideal shared by all Radiants. A pledge to value life, seek strength for the right reasons, and walk a path of purpose over outcome.
quotes: Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before destination.

ideals.label: second ideal
ideals.description: The Stoneward swears to stand when others fall, to be unwavering in the face of hardship.
quotes: I will be there when I am needed.
I will not break, no matter the pressure.

ideals.label: third ideal
ideals.description: They promise to endure through suffering, to serve without reward, and to remain true in even the longest fights.
quotes: I will not retreat from pain, nor falter in patience.
My strength is not for myself alone.

ideals.label: fourth ideal
ideals.description: The Stoneward accepts the burden of inspiring others, becoming the example that holds the line when all seems lost.
quotes: When others fall, I will remain standing.

ideals.label: fifth ideal
ideals.description: They embody the eternal stone, unmovable, faithful, and unshaken even by the end of the world.
quotes: I am the foundation others may stand upon.
